svg.text: a C compiler written from scratch in Rust; e-graph optimizer with certificates; target AArch64 and the Linux 6.18 kernel
no LLVM, no GCC in the pipeline
C-HIR interpreter and EvoIR interpreter are
runs through both, and a difference is a defect
each e-graph union emits an EVP2 certificate;
evo-proofcheck replays it against the before and
after programs and shares no code with the optimizer
source IR, optimized IR, machine IR and native
EvoIR spec 1.9.68 and EvoMIR spec 0.15 hold every rule
before a rule is written, the behaviour is checked in a
sealed container with GCC 14.2 and Clang 19.1
when the two disagree, the rule refuses the construct
anything unspecified is refused with a numbered diagnostic
tests first: a commit whose failures are listed in advance,
then the implementation, then a receipt with the numbers
an agent that finds a gap in the spec stops and reports;
it can run the reference compilers, it cannot guess
every status number is produced by a script
survey: compile all 2,798 kernel units, group them by the
first diagnostic, write one rule per group, repeat
kernel: GCC builds it, EvoCC replaces units, kbuild relinks,
QEMU boots it, a failure is bisected to one unit
programs: c-testsuite, GCC torture, zlib, zstd, Mbed TLS, musl
kernel units lower to EvoIR with no
diagnostic; the rest stop at a known
C programs agree with clang on
Darwin and with GCC-14 on Linux,
inside a kernel that boots; GCC
docs/status.md is rendered from the receipts
